items.name: Åkerdylle
items.observations: Original pedagogical watercolor of Sonchus arvensis with a tall leafy stem, a branched group of golden-yellow all-ligulate composite heads, narrow hairy green involucral bracts, alternate deeply lobed slightly prickly leaves that clasp the stem, and an exposed root crown with spreading horizontal roots. Compared with reference morphology and inspected against black.
items.limitations: Stylized educational rendering, not a photograph, voucher specimen or stand-alone identification key. Microscopic glandular hairs and flower-head details are simplified.
